subject: Acceptance runway forensics and escalation diary
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@clearwell.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP milestone review — acceptance window concerns

Markus / Ben —

Thanks for the runbook yesterday. Quick update from procurement: the internal security review pushed the SOC evidence handoff into the week of July 5, which means our acceptance window (targeted for July 9) is now very tight. I ran this with Marta in Procurement and she asked for a short impact summary and any alternatives we can offer to avoid moving the go-live.

High level from our side: we can try a limited-scope acceptance (API subset + synthetic traffic) to validate core flows while SOC docs conclude, or shift the full acceptance by two weeks. Marta asked for recommended next steps by EOD Monday (June 28).

Sophie
Senior PM, ClearWell Health

--
Attachment: clearwell-soc-ask.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@clearwell.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP milestone review — acceptance window concerns

Sophie / Marta —

Appreciate the heads-up. I pulled the MAP risk log and a short forensics summary and attached it (redwood_map_risk_log_v3.xlsx). Quick notes:
- Root cause: SOC evidence collection delayed due to a missing HSM cert rotation record. Customer security team is on it but timeline is uncertain.
- Impact: if SOC evidence completes by July 2 we can keep July 9 acceptance with a limited DST (delayed full traffic) and a contingency cutover on July 16.
- Alternatives: 1) Limited acceptance (API + partners) on July 9 + full acceptance July 16; 2) Move full acceptance to July 23 and use the interim window for joint runbooks and data retention tests.

I recommend Alternative 1 as the least business-impactful path. Ben, Lauren — can you confirm operational feasibility for a limited-scope acceptance and the checklist items we need? Camila I'll need you to draft the short customer-facing rebaseline note we can send to Marta and procurement.

Markus
Director, GTM Engineering
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood_map_risk_log_v3.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@clearwell.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@acmeinc.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP milestone review — acceptance window concerns

On Mon, Jun 28, 2027 at 08:15 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I recommend Alternative 1 as the least business-impactful path. Ben, Lauren — can you confirm operational feasibility for a limited-scope acceptance and the checklist items we need? Camila I'll need you to draft the short customer-facing rebaseline note we can send to Marta and procurement.

We ran this with Ops and CS: limited-scope acceptance is doable but requires these:
- Enable API-only routing (no external partner traffic) and a synthetic load (10k tokens/min) for 4 hours
- Temporary SLA waiver on peak concurrency during the window (we'll document in the MAP)
- Backout playbook tested and signed off by CS (30-minute rollback target)

I'll own the ops checklist and the test schedule. Lauren, can you confirm CS availability for a canary on July 9? Camila — when you have the draft note, ping me and I'll attach the Ops checklist.

Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer

--
Attachment: proposed-rebaseline.docx (attachment stub)

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@clearwell.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP milestone review — acceptance window concerns

Hi Sophie / Marta —

Thanks for the transparency; we want to avoid a hard slip if possible. Per the internal forensics and Ops checklist below, Redwood recommends the following path (formalized ask):

1) July 9: Limited acceptance (API subset + synthetic traffic) — purpose: validate core inference, routing, and cache behavior before full production traffic.
2) July 16: Full acceptance window (contingent on SOC evidence completion). If SOC evidence is still outstanding, we hold July 16 as a soft target and run a second limited acceptance with expanded test vectors.

Operational notes and commitments from Redwood:
- We will supply the Ops checklist and runbook by EOD Tuesday (July 5).
- CS (Lauren) will run the canary and be on-call during the window.
- We will update the MAP (shared link below) with a clear rollback decision gate and sign-off steps.

Let us know if the limited acceptance is acceptable to Procurement. If Procurement requires an unchanged July 9 for full acceptance, we will need a signed contingent SLA amendment and credit escrow. Otherwise we propose to proceed with the two-stage acceptance above.

Camila Reyes
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

--
